runtime.parent_image_policy: The derived image label org.sparkcache.parent-image-id must equal the immutable local ID of the parent image used by the build.

sparkcache.root_requirement: Use one dedicated rank-local host directory per physical rank, mounted at /cache/jit on every rank.

evidence.conditions: Four directly cabled NVIDIA DGX Spark systems served the pinned target and public BF16 DFlash2 checkpoints at TP4/DCP1 with a 524288-token model limit, 8192-token scheduler budget, 32 sequences, 12 GiB FP8 key-value slab per rank, asynchronous scheduling, native prefix caching, chunked prefill, aligned recurrent cache, FlashKDA prefill, FULL_AND_PIECEWISE target graphs, vLLM-selected DFlash FULL graphs, dedicated rank-local SparkCache roots, and the exact SparkCache source and vLLM lease contract recorded in this file.
evidence.measurement: A deterministic 8192-token reusable span was stored on all ranks in a fresh cache namespace. All four serving containers were replaced without deleting their cache roots. Every rank reported three manifests checked and offered with zero rejected. An identical request then formed all-rank quorum, restored external target context, completed generation, and was followed by an uncached semantic canary, target-manifest verification, and transport/process health checks.
evidence.result: All four ranks committed the same reusable-context digest. The restored request reported 8192 external-prefix hit tokens and completed in 1.509 seconds. Rank restore times were 155.6, 147.2, 194.0, and 151.8 milliseconds. DFlash emitted 301 draft tokens from 43 drafts and accepted 112 tokens. The semantic canary completed in 1.176 seconds with finish reason stop and suffix SPARKCACHE_GLM53_OK. Ranks 0, 2, and 3 passed strict verification of all 59 target repository files. Rank 1 had the same 59 verified files plus Hugging Face cache metadata, so expected-file verification passed and strict extra-file mode rejected the additional metadata. Every rank retained 24 RTS VLLM::Worker RDMA queue pairs with zero preemptions, container restarts, out-of-memory events, or fatal-log matches.
evidence.conclusion: The recorded TP4/DCP1 composition restores persistent target-model context after a coordinated engine restart while DFlash2 continues seven-token speculative decoding and the service continues correct generation.
limitations: The receipt qualifies only the four recorded base/derived image pairs, source-tree digest, source contracts, checkpoints, topology, serving geometry, and 8192-token restored span.
A rebuilt or redistributed image has implemented status until it passes the same live gate.
The first request after API startup recomputed because the scheduler had not received a complete four-rank inventory checkpoint; the following identical request formed quorum and restored.
The receipt does not establish throughput neutrality or restore performance for spans larger than 8192 tokens.
Streaming snapshots, native direct restore, MTP drafting, and other DFlash checkpoints are unsupported by this evidence.
Rank 1 contained additional .cache/huggingface metadata. All 59 expected repository files matched; a byte-for-byte no-extra-files claim applies only to ranks 0, 2, and 3.
The target repository does not record its base-checkpoint revision, and the NCCL binary receipt does not bind the binary to an upstream source commit.
evidence.artifact_scope: The four base/derived image pairs, SparkCache source digest, seven-file vLLM source contract, target and draft revisions, TP4/DCP1 topology, and serving/cache settings recorded in this recipe.
